direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; columns 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; interactive targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before reducing type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Preserve the second official logo in the opening story at native aspect, but enlarge the factory SVG into the unused lower-left space and align Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks on one shared scale.
Reduce the oversized mission panel crowding at 1366x768; cap inspector evidence list with internal scroll and keep DOES NOT MATCH fixed spanning the 40-unit gap.
Add 2px neon focus ring to evidence rows and bidirectional highlighting between ev-cert-qty, ev-recv-qty and SVG nodes.
Keep Route health pre-flight (nonce, identity) as a separate fieldset from Investigation source evidence, each with its own status line, heading and action; never merge their states.
Enlarge SVG plan cards and evidence markers to 11px minimum; the three option chips below the jobs are currently cramped against the stage edge.
Shorten inspector helper text to one status sentence so the Run Sample investigation primary stays visible without panel compression.
Make each option a native radio card at least 44px tall; selecting it must open the typed consent form, with the selected state shown by border, marker and text, not color alone.
Sync radio selection to the SVG: dim non-feasible or non-selected routes, keep 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 in tabular type.
Disable Review recovery option until a path is chosen and announce that rule in the action-bar centre status instead of leaving an ambiguous enabled primary.
Keep proposed tasks visibly untracked until approval, but un-truncate t1-t3 titles in the stage panel; refit by widening cards and allowing two-line titles at 13px.
Remove duplicate proposal summaries between stage and inspector; stage shows sequence and dependency, inspector shows the approvable task detail and Decline/Review controls.
Give task selector buttons 1, 2, 3 aria-pressed state, arrow-key movement and a visible focus ring.
Preserve red exclusively for CELL-MILL-2: use red cross-hatch, STOPPED marker and PREVIEW text only there, while the preview banner explains the route will not pass through that cell.
Enlarge the MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts accepted-recovery callout so it does not collide with RECOVERY FLOW labelling on the SVG line.
Make the machine selector at least 40px tall with label, focus ring and aria-describedby tying selection to invalidation of Use verified substitute.
Retain stoppedRed only on CELL-MILL-2 with OFFLINE-STOPPED text and cross-hatch; ensure no neon feasible route is drawn through it and CELL-MILL-1 remains the viable path.
Again separate pre-flight nonce/identity route health from the investigation evidence task after the second shock; reset each status independently and label the evidence panel not run.
Raise constrained Split available capacity label contrast and add hatch plus text so constraint is not carried by dim color alone.
Style the constrained Split option as disabled with hatch, x marker and reason text; remove its finish and cost dashes ambiguity by stating Split requires at least two online compatible cells.
Keep prior acceptance invalidated status in both inspector and action bar, and require a fresh selection before Review revised option activates; selection then opens the typed consent form.
Align the 120/80 mismatch tracks and feasible option dots so the revised comparison reads in one left-to-right scan.

Show 3 blocked prior tasks and 3 proposed replacements as two clearly separated groups; blocked tasks stay tracked and visible while replacements remain untracked until approval beside the approved revised plan.
Fix inspector clipping: give the blocked list its own internal scroll region, enlarge hit targets, and keep Review/Decline/Approve controls pinned visible at 1366x768.
On the stage, mark CELL-MILL-2 only in stoppedRed and show the accepted flow through CELL-MILL-1 in neon; un-truncate the t2 and t3 task titles.

Clarify the gated sequence Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet, Retain independent checkpoint with numbered locked states, focus order and aria-live result announcements; keep only Verify ledger as the single primary.
Enlarge the passphrase field to 44px, keep its 16-160 character checklist adjacent, and hold helper text to one sentence to preserve viewport fit.
Add pattern plus text to the three stage proof blocks so READY and LOCKED are distinguishable without color.
Confirm completion retains CELL-MILL-2 in stoppedRed with OFFLINE-STOPPED text while all proof blocks show SEALED with check, pattern and text.
Remove the duplicate enabled-looking Verify ledger and Export controls emphasis in the retained inspector, or label them Complete with disabled state and pointer style removed.
Keep the final status line PACKET SEALED, 18 events, revised plan accepted in the action bar and add a single concise completion focus target for keyboard users.
